high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque scene at sunset, featuring a mosque with two prominent minarets situated on the waterfront. The mosque is illuminated by warm, golden lights, which contrast beautifully with the vibrant hues of the sky transitioning from deep purples to soft pinks and oranges. The water reflects these colors, creating a mirror-like effect that enhances the tranquil atmosphere. In the foreground, there is a stone walkway bordered by metal chains, leading towards the mosque.
